sent_bad: It is "already quite uniform" and standardized/digitized, so it can be used in automated and statistical underwriting methodologies to price loans.
Because of its uniformity, large lenders can handle it with automated technological systems, making reporting less expensive per applicant.

In short, hard information is uniform, standardized, and amenable to automated underwriting, while soft information is idiosyncratic, circumstantial, and requires labor-intensive, relationship-based underwriting.
